reviewDecisions.rationale: A funded/regulatory channel change already showed large realized sales growth and a direct listed operator exists.
Economically material national market design; retain to test whether current V1.9 can map it to company earnings.
Major regulatory destruction/redistribution event; likely risk filter but should not be absent from the event universe.
Cross-company regulatory demand shock; direct incidence must be mapped rather than assumed.
Material credit and supplier-payment state change that can invalidate or redistribute property-chain opportunities.
Large national price reset can change device market share and margins; positive expression requires company-level bid/cost proof.
